about.title: about me
about.paragraph1:
As a software developer with 3+ years of continuous learning and hands-on experience, my, focus is on front-end development, utilizing modern frontend frameworks like React to create intuitive user experiences. I enjoy leveraging AI as part of my development workflow for debugging, architectural decisions, improving code quality, and accelerating learning while maintaining strong problem-solving fundamentals. 
 I am passionate about continuously improving my skills and collaborating with dynamic teams to deliver impactful projects. I am open to collaborate on interesting projects that add value.
about.paragraph2: Background: Before transitioning into software development, I earned a degree in Homeopathy, an alternative holistic system of medicine that emphasizes understanding individuals as a whole and identifying root causes rather than only addressing symptoms. This mindset has strongly influenced my approach to software development where I focus on understanding underlying causes of bugs and technical challenges to build effective, long-term solutions rather than temporary fixes.
about.paragraph3: When I am not coding, I like to spend time with my family.

philosophy.title: How I Build
philosophy.subtitle: The principles that guide every decision I make as a developer

ux.title: User Experience First
ux.description: Every decision I make starts with one question: 'Will this make the user's experience better?' I don't consider a feature done until it feels intuitive, accessible and purposeful.

architecture.title: Architecture Before Code
architecture.description: Before writing a single line, I think about scalability. Will this solution hold up at 10x the current load? Is this component reusable? Am I creating technical debt for future me? During my previous internship, while working on a React + TypeScript application, I encountered a situation where data was being passed through props across various components. I suggested introducing global state management with Redux Toolkit — reducing unnecessary API calls, making the system more scalable, and giving me a deeper understanding of data flow and system design.

ship.title: Build → Ship → Improve
ship.description: I believe in getting something working first, then making it fast. Premature optimization kills momentum. I ship, measure, then optimize — backed by real data like Lighthouse scores, not assumptions.

projects.subtitle: A selection of projects that showcase my skills and experience

recipes.title: Fullstack Recipes App
recipes.description: A fullstack recipes app designed for content creators who share recipes on social media but lack a dedicated platform. Registered users can create recipes and other users can search for and view recipes by category or cuisine. Features include global search with dropdown results, user reviews and ratings, PDF download, and AI-powered PDF upload that auto-populates recipe details by extracting and parsing text — eliminating manual data entry.

inventory.title: Product & Inventory Management App
inventory.description: A fullstack app developed as Lexicon's final project. Registered users can create groups, add members with role assignment, create categories and items within each group. Supports full CRUD for all entities based on the user's role in the group.

shopzone.title: Shopzone — MERN Stack E-commerce
shopzone.description: A frontend React project converted to a fullstack e-commerce application with authentication. Users can add items to favorites, manage a cart, and update quantities. Migrated from Context API to Redux Toolkit for scalable state management.

expenseTracker.title: React Native Expense Tracker
expenseTracker.description: A mobile expense tracking app where users can create, read, update and delete expenses, set a maximum expense limit and receive a notification when the limit is exceeded.
